events.verdict: Williams (CHA) firms up in a screening position in O'Neale's (PHX) path and does not deliver contact.
O'Neale (PHX) reaches in and makes contact to Ball's (CHA) arm, affecting his pass.
Booker (PHX) cleanly dislodges the ball from Williams (CHA). The contact between Williams and Beal (PHX) after the ball is stolen is incidental.
Martin (CHA) commits a take foul on Booker (PHX). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Beal (PHX) places a forearm against Ball (CHA) as he briefly loses control of his dribble.
Durant (PHX) reaches in and makes contact with the ball, causing it to briefly become loose. Ball (CHA) then legally takes a dribble.
Miller (CHA) moves his pivot foot heel-to-toe.
Dunn (PHX) is in a legal guarding position when Ball (CHA) loses his footing on his own accord.
Miller (CHA) commits a take foul on Booker (PHX).
Beal (PHX) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Ball (CHA) when he starts his upward shooting motion.
